fact: The Gambia Competition and Consumer Protection Commission's study says the Consumer Protection Act 2014 requires alternative dispute resolution for consumer claims and set up a Consumer Protection Tribunal with unlimited jurisdiction over claims including digital transactions.

The Ministry of Trade, with the GCCPC and Commonwealth support, is working with a consultant to revise the Competition and Consumer Protection Acts to address digital markets, including e-commerce and digital financial platforms.
